regions.summary: Xin'an and Mianchi counties plus Yima, west of Luoyang along the Jian River and the Yellow River.

candidates.name: Mianchi
candidates.meaning: "Mian pond": the Shui jing zhu says a pool lay among the Xiong'er hills here. Site of the Qin-Zhao Mianchi meeting.
candidates.fit: Holds 95% of Mianchi's people (32% of the region); Mianchi commandery and Mianchi county had seats here. Second to Xin'an by people.
candidates.recognisability: Current admin unit, no check needed. Also the home county of Yangshao village.
candidates.source_note: 渑池因山水而得名...熊耳山，山际有池，世谓之渑池

candidates.name: Xin'an
candidates.meaning: "New peace": Qin county name, kept for over 1,600 years.
candidates.fit: Largest unit: 43% of the region's people and the whole county. The name is common elsewhere (Xin'an River, Anhui) but not a conflict on this map.
candidates.recognisability: Current admin unit, no check needed.
candidates.source_note: 新安县秦代建县

candidates.name: Yangshao
candidates.meaning: Village in Mianchi where the Yangshao culture (5000-3000 BC painted pottery) was found in 1921 and named for it.
candidates.fit: The village lies inside the region; the culture is wider than the region, so it names the place only by way of the village.
candidates.recognisability: Culture has its own zh-wiki article; village and town articles too; 53 hits with 渑池, top ones about this place.
candidates.source_note: 位于河南省三门峡市渑池县仰韶乡仰韶村，仰韶文化因此而得名

regions.summary: North of Luoyang across the Mang hills: Mengjin, Laocheng, Yanshi's north, Chanhe.

candidates.name: Mengjin
candidates.meaning: "Meng ferry": the crossing at Meng, named for the Mengtu fief; where King Wu of Zhou is said to have gathered the lords before attacking Shang.
candidates.fit: 41% of the region's people and 71% of the district; the seat of Mengjin county (1215-1911) and of Han-Wei Luoyang's surroundings lie here.
candidates.recognisability: Current admin unit, no check needed.
candidates.source_note: 孟津之名可追溯至夏朝，“孟”指其位于孟涂氏封国，“津”指渡口

candidates.name: Mangshan
candidates.meaning: Loess ridge north of Luoyang along the Yellow River, also called Beimang. Burial ground of many emperors.
candidates.fit: The ridge runs through Mengjin, Laocheng and Yanshi, which are the three biggest parts of the region.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 725 hits with 河南, top ones about this ridge and the tombs.
candidates.source_note: 位于河南省洛阳市北，黄河南岸；邙山陵墓群

regions.summary: Sanmenxia city (Hubin, Shan), Pinglu across the river in Shanxi, and Lingbao's east.

candidates.name: Sanmenxia
candidates.meaning: "Three-gate gorge": Yu's axe split the Yellow River into three channels (human, god, ghost gates). The dam and city grew up here in the 1950s.
candidates.fit: Holds the city centre (Hubin 27%, Shan 29%); Sanmenxia's own urban population is under 1M so the city rule does not apply.
candidates.recognisability: Current admin unit, no check needed.
candidates.source_note: 相传大禹治水，使神斧将高山劈成“人门”、“神门”、“鬼门”三道峡谷

candidates.name: Shanzhou
candidates.meaning: From Shan, the plateau where the Duke of Zhou and Duke of Shao split the realm. The Shaan of Shaanxi comes from here.
candidates.fit: Prefecture seat (487-1911, 1,194 years) at old Shan, inside the region, and the old name of Sanmenxia. Also the name of a Sanmenxia district, so some confusion with Shaanxi.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article for the district; widely known as the source of Shaanxi.
candidates.source_note: 陕西省省名中的“陕”字源于此地; CHGIS 陕州 487-1911

regions.summary: Luoyang's western city: Jianxi and Xigong, the old industrial and prefecture centre.

candidates.name: Luoyang
candidates.meaning: "North of the Luo": the north bank of a river is the yang side.
candidates.fit: Over 1M urban population, so the most central region takes the city name. CHGIS puts the Ming-Qing Henan prefecture seat and the Sui Luoyang county in this region; the Luoyang dot of the city list falls in region 6, so Anita may prefer to give the name there.
candidates.recognisability: Current admin unit, no check needed.
candidates.source_note: 洛阳位于洛水之北，水之北谓之“阳”，故名洛阳

candidates.name: Jianxi
candidates.meaning: "West of the Jian River": district built in the 1950s for the tractor and bearing plants.
candidates.fit: 70% of the region's people.
candidates.recognisability: Current district name; too new and too plain to suggest.
candidates.source_note: 涧西区 (no zh-wiki article in sources)

regions.notes: Luoyang's city regions are 4, 6 and 2. CHGIS puts the Ming-Qing prefecture seat in 4; the city list dot is in 6. Pick one for the name.

regions.summary: East Luoyang and west Zhengzhou's edge: Yanshi and Gongyi, between the Mang hills and Mount Song.

candidates.name: Yanshi
candidates.meaning: "Halt the army": King Wu is said to have stopped here after defeating Shang and put down his arms. Site of the Shang city and of Erlitou.
candidates.fit: 48% of the region's people and 82% of Yanshi; seat of Yanshi county (249 BC-1911) is here.
candidates.recognisability: Current admin unit, no check needed.
candidates.source_note: 周武王东征伐纣凯旋，在此筑城“息偃戎师”而得名

candidates.name: Gongyi
candidates.meaning: Gong was an Eastern Zhou state and a Qin county. Du Fu's birthplace and the Song imperial tombs; the Yi in the modern name means righteousness.
candidates.fit: 45% of the region's people and 70% of Gongyi, which runs on east into another batch, so check it is not used there.
candidates.recognisability: Current admin unit, no check needed.
candidates.source_note: 巩义因地扼古都洛阳，故历史上有“东都锁钥”之称

regions.notes: Gongyi's other 30% is in a neighbouring batch.

regions.summary: Luolong district south of the Luo, with the Longmen gorge and the Yichuan edge.

candidates.name: Longmen
candidates.meaning: "Dragon gate": the gorge where the Yi River cuts between two hills, site of the Longmen Grottoes (UNESCO).
candidates.fit: The gorge and grottoes lie in this region; Luolong district's own name is Luo plus Long (from Longmen).
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article for the hill; widely known worldwide. The same pinyin names places in Shaanxi and Guangdong, not on this map nearby.
candidates.source_note: 龙门山位于中国河南洛阳城南12公里处...古称“伊阙”

candidates.name: Yique
candidates.meaning: "Gate of the Yi": the old name of the Longmen gorge; two hills face each other like a gatehouse. One of Luoyang's eight passes; Bai Qi beat Han and Wei here in 293 BC.
candidates.fit: Names the gorge in this region, but the Yique county seat (596-1071) was in Yichuan, region 8.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki mentions only; 44 hits with 河南, top ones about Longmen. Weak.
candidates.source_note: 因此古称“伊阙”; 洛阳八关 includes 伊阙关

candidates.name: Luolong
candidates.meaning: Luo plus Long (Longmen): district created 1980s south of the river.
candidates.fit: 92% of the region's people.
candidates.recognisability: Recent district name, not a place name people know.
candidates.source_note: 洛龙区 article

regions.summary: Middle Luo River valley and the Xiong'er hills: Yiyang, Luoning, Lushi.

candidates.name: Xiong'er
candidates.meaning: "Bear's ears": two peaks said to look like bear ears. The range divides the Luo and Yi basins. Luoning was called Xiong'er county 553-618.
candidates.fit: Runs through Luoning and Lushi, over half of the region, and gives its old county name to Luoning.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 123 hits with 河南, top ones about the range.
candidates.source_note: 位于中国河南省境内，洛阳西南，为秦岭东段的支脉

candidates.name: Yiyang
candidates.meaning: Han-era Yiyang county, 1,591 years in CHGIS, on the Luoyang road.
candidates.fit: Largest unit: 43% of the region's people and 92% of the county; Xiongzhou and Yiyang commandery seated here. Same pinyin as Yiyang in Hunan.
candidates.recognisability: Current admin unit, no check needed.
candidates.source_note: 宜阳县 (seats 宜阳郡, 熊州 in CHGIS)

candidates.name: Luoning
candidates.meaning: "Luo calm": Yongning county (643-1911) renamed in 1913.
candidates.fit: 34% of the region's people and the whole county, on the middle Luo.
candidates.recognisability: Current admin unit, no check needed.
candidates.source_note: 1913年改为洛宁县

regions.summary: Yichuan and Ruyang: the plain where the Yi River leaves the hills, and the Ru's upper valley.

candidates.name: Yichuan
candidates.meaning: "Yi plain": the Yi River basin. County made 1932 from the old Equality and Freedom counties.
candidates.fit: 57% of the region's people; Yichuan and Yique county seats (CHGIS) lay here. Also the name of the Yi plain around the river.
candidates.recognisability: Current admin unit, no check needed.
candidates.source_note: 1932年，平等、自由两县合并，成立伊川县

candidates.name: Ruyang
candidates.meaning: "North of the Ru": formerly Yiyang county, renamed 1959 for the Beiru River.
candidates.fit: 36% of the region's people and the whole county. Easily confused with Ru'nan (once also Ruyang).
candidates.recognisability: Current admin unit, no check needed.
candidates.source_note: 本县更名为汝阳县

regions.summary: Ruzhou and its coal and Ru River country.

candidates.name: Ruzhou
candidates.meaning: "Ru prefecture": from the Ru River, named by Sui in 606. Famous for Ru ware, the Song imperial porcelain.
candidates.fit: 92% of the region's people and 93% of Ruzhou; prefecture seat since 606.
candidates.recognisability: Current admin unit, no check needed.
candidates.source_note: 隋炀帝大业二年（606年）改伊州为汝州

regions.summary: High Funiu hills at the head of the Yi River: Song, Luanchuan, a bit of Yichuan.

candidates.name: Funiu
candidates.meaning: "Crouching ox": the range east of Qinling, about 400 km long.
candidates.fit: Luanchuan and Song hold its highest and widest part (Laojun, Jigejian); the range also runs into neighbouring regions.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 673 hits with 河南, top ones about the range.
candidates.source_note: 伏牛山位於中國河南省西部，为秦岭的东延余脉

candidates.name: Songxian
candidates.meaning: Named after Songzhou (1151-1234), whose seat was in the county.
candidates.fit: 54% of the region's people and the whole county; Songzhou and Yiyang commanderies sat here.
candidates.recognisability: Current admin unit, no check needed.

candidates.name: Luanchuan
candidates.meaning: Old name Luanzhou, "phoenix": a luan bird is said to have perched here; the town on the stream.
candidates.fit: 36% of the region's people and the whole county; where the Yi River rises.
candidates.recognisability: Current admin unit, no check needed.
candidates.source_note: 栾川古称“鸾州”，因远古时期有形似凤凰的鸾鸟在此栖息而得名

regions.notes: Funiu is a range shared with 13, 15, 16; it is only suggested here.

regions.summary: Baofeng and Jia counties on the Beiru River.

candidates.name: Baofeng
candidates.meaning: "Treasure abundance": Emperor Huizong's name (1120) for the area's liquor, Ru kilns and ironworks.
candidates.fit: 47% of the region's people and 97% of the county; Ru official kiln site Qingliangsi is here.
candidates.recognisability: Current admin unit, no check needed.
candidates.source_note: “宝货兴发”，天子赐名“宝丰县”

candidates.name: Jia
candidates.meaning: Jia was a Zheng town; Qin county from 207 BC. Home of the Three Su tombs.
candidates.fit: 47% of the region's people and 87% of the county. Write as Jiaxian: the county has one character.
candidates.recognisability: Current admin unit, no check needed.
candidates.source_note: 秦朝时初置郏县

regions.summary: Pingdingshan city: Xinhua, Weidong, Zhanhe.

candidates.name: Pingdingshan
candidates.meaning: "Flat-top mountain": the low peaks north of the city have flat summits.
candidates.fit: Holds the city's three core districts; urban population about 1M. Founded 1957 as a coal city.
candidates.recognisability: Current admin unit, no check needed.
candidates.source_note: 因环绕市区北面的山峰皆平坦如削故得名

regions.summary: Lushan county and the Shahe's mountain headwaters.

candidates.name: Lushan
candidates.meaning: "Lu mountain": old name Luyang; Zhou renamed it Lushan after the hill.
candidates.fit: 73% of the region's people and 98.5% of the county.
candidates.recognisability: Current admin unit, no check needed.
candidates.source_note: 鲁山县，古称鲁阳

regions.summary: Ye county and Wuyang on the Sha plain east of Lushan.

candidates.name: Yexian
candidates.meaning: Ye was Chu's Ye city; Duke Ye (Shen Zhuliang) of the "dragon lover" story; origin of the Ye surname.
candidates.fit: 55% of the region's people and 82% of the county. The county has one character, so Yexian.
candidates.recognisability: Current admin unit, no check needed.
candidates.source_note: 叶县是叶姓的发源地 (Pingdingshan article)

candidates.name: Wuyang
candidates.meaning: "Sunny side of the Wu": Wu River's north bank. Han marquis of Wuyang was Fan Kuai.
candidates.fit: 35% of the region's people; only 77% of the county sits here, and the rest lies in a neighbouring batch.
candidates.recognisability: Current admin unit, no check needed.
candidates.source_note: 因位于舞水之阳而得名

regions.summary: Dan River and Laoguan River hills: Xixia, Xichuan, Shangnan (Shaanxi).

candidates.name: Danjiang
candidates.meaning: "Dan River": the Han's main tributary, which flows from Shangluo through Shangnan and Xichuan into Danjiangkou Reservoir.
candidates.fit: The river and the reservoir run through Xichuan and Shangnan, over half of the region. Chu's first capital Danyang is on it.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 344 hits with 河南, top ones about this place. Danjiangkou city is across in Hubei.
candidates.source_note: 丹江为汉江一级支流; 淅川县全部位于丹江口水库流域

candidates.name: Xixia
candidates.meaning: "West gorge": Xixiakou, the gorge route to Shaanxi and Hubei. Dinosaur eggs found 1993.
candidates.fit: 39% of the region's people and 85% of the county. Same pinyin as the Western Xia dynasty, which may sit on another map.
candidates.recognisability: Current admin unit, no check needed.
candidates.source_note: 西峡县，原名西峡口，因位于河南连接陕西及湖北的峡口而得名

candidates.name: Xichuan
candidates.meaning: "Xi stream plain": named for the Xi River plain. Core of the Chu state: Danyang and 19 Chu kings.
candidates.fit: 36% of the region's people but only 53% of the county; the rest is in region 17.
candidates.recognisability: Current admin unit, no check needed.
candidates.source_note: 因淅水纵贯境内形成百里冲积平川而得名

regions.summary: Nanzhao and Fangcheng in the hills above Nanyang basin.

candidates.name: Nanzhao
candidates.meaning: "South of Zhao": named for the Nanzhao inn on the Wan-Luo road.
candidates.fit: 50% of the region's people and the whole county. Pinyin matches Nanzhao, the Yunnan kingdom.
candidates.recognisability: Current admin unit, no check needed.
candidates.source_note: 因县城东北隅的南召店是宛洛大道上商旅息居的名驿得而名

candidates.name: Fangcheng
candidates.meaning: "Square wall": the Chu Great Wall of the Spring and Autumn period.
candidates.fit: 33% of the region's people but only 41% of the county, the rest lies in region 19. Pinyin matches Fangchenggang in Guangxi.
candidates.recognisability: Current admin unit, no check needed.
candidates.source_note: 方城县在...唐河上游; 楚长城遗址

regions.summary: Neixiang, Dengzhou's north and Xichuan's south in the basin's western rim.

candidates.name: Neixiang
candidates.meaning: "Inner village": Sui name for the Xi county seat inside the pass. The Qing county yamen survives intact.
candidates.fit: 41% of the region's people and the whole county.
candidates.recognisability: Current admin unit, no check needed.
candidates.source_note: 下辖内乡县...今存完整清代县衙

candidates.name: Guanjun
candidates.meaning: "First of armies": Han Wudi named Huo Qubing's marquisate Guanjun for his exploits against the Xiongnu.
candidates.fit: Guanjun county (110 BC-629, 739 years) seat lay in the region.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 28 hits with 邓州, top ones about this place. Obscure.
candidates.source_note: 冠军县，治所在今河南省邓州市西北张村镇冠军村一带

candidates.name: Dengzhou
candidates.meaning: Deng state; Deng surname origin. County-level city.
candidates.fit: 37% of the region's people but only 22% of Dengzhou; the city centre is in region 22.
candidates.recognisability: Current admin unit, no check needed.
candidates.source_note: 邓州市

regions.summary: Zhenping county and part of Wolong, north-west of Nanyang.

candidates.name: Zhenping
candidates.meaning: "Suppress and pacify": Jin name (1227) after a peasant uprising on Wuduo Mountain. Known for jade carving.
candidates.fit: 77% of the region's people and 98.5% of the county.
candidates.recognisability: Current admin unit, no check needed.
candidates.source_note: 金代正大三年（1226年），境内五垛山农民起义被镇压平息，故次年取“镇慑和平定”之意设县称镇平

regions.summary: Sheqi, Wancheng's north-east and part of Fangcheng on the Tang's headwaters.

candidates.name: Sheqi
candidates.meaning: Sheqi 1965: the old shop was Sheqi ("credit flag"), where Liu Xiu bought a wine flag on credit; Zhou Enlai changed the character to "commune flag".
candidates.fit: 57% of the region's people and 89% of the county; its seat Shedian was one of China's four great merchant towns.
candidates.recognisability: Current admin unit, no check needed.
candidates.source_note: 赊店镇...因东汉时期刘秀举义兵赊旗而得名

candidates.name: Shedian
candidates.meaning: "Credit shop": the original name of Sheqi's town and its liquor.
candidates.fit: The town is the county seat inside the region; the name is the older, better known one.
candidates.recognisability: Named in the Sheqi article; known for tea-road trade and for a liquor.
candidates.source_note: 赊店镇，又称赊旗镇

regions.summary: Nanyang city centre: most of Wolong and part of Wancheng.

candidates.name: Nanyang
candidates.meaning: "South of the mountain, north of the river": south of Funiu, north of the Han.
candidates.fit: Urban population over 1M; the region holds the old Wan city seat of Nanyang commandery since 272 BC.
candidates.recognisability: Current admin unit, no check needed.
candidates.source_note: “以在南山之南，汉水之北也”

regions.summary: Xinye and Wancheng's south on the Bai River plain.

candidates.name: Xinye
candidates.meaning: "New field": a new plain on the old lake bed, or the field of Xindu; Han county from 207 BC. Home of Deng Yu, Yin Lihua and Liu Bei's base before the Three Kingdoms.
candidates.fit: 44% of the region's people and 93% of the county; Xinye commandery seat and 1,587 years as county.
candidates.recognisability: Current admin unit, no check needed.
candidates.source_note: 新野之名由来, 历史名人: 邓禹、阴丽华

candidates.name: Wancheng
candidates.meaning: Wan, the old name of Nanyang, plus city: the district is the ancient capital site.
candidates.fit: 46% of the region's people but 64% of the district; its name belongs to the central Nanyang city.
candidates.recognisability: Current admin unit, no check needed.
candidates.source_note: 历史上为古宛城所在

regions.summary: Dengzhou, the large county-level city on the basin's west side.

candidates.name: Dengzhou
candidates.meaning: Deng state and surname origin; Dengzhou prefecture (583-1270).
candidates.fit: 98% of the region's people and 78% of the city; seat of Dengzhou for 642 years.
candidates.recognisability: Current admin unit, no check needed.
candidates.source_note: 邓州，古称邓或穰

regions.summary: Tanghe county on the Tang River.

candidates.name: Tanghe
candidates.meaning: "Tang River": county named in 1923 for the river; Tang was a Zhou state.
candidates.fit: 97% of the region's people and 94% of the county.
candidates.recognisability: Current admin unit, no check needed.
candidates.source_note: 得名于流经境内的唐河

regions.summary: Yellow River bend at the three-province corner: Lingbao (Henan), Ruicheng (Shanxi), Tongguan (Shaanxi).

candidates.name: Hongnong
candidates.meaning: Han commandery (113 BC) and county named for the Hongnong stream; seat beside the Hangu pass.
candidates.fit: Seat at the old Hangu pass site inside Lingbao (the region's largest part, 49%); commandery covered Sanmenxia and Shangluo, so Lingbao and the pass, not Ruicheng or Tongguan.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article for commandery and county, 433 hits with Henan, top ones about this place.
candidates.source_note: 于函谷关边置弘农郡；弘农县因弘农涧而得名；治所在今河南省三门峡市灵宝市北

candidates.name: Fenglingdu
candidates.meaning: "Fengling ford": the largest ancient Yellow River crossing, named for the tomb of Feng Hou (Huangdi's minister).
candidates.fit: Sits exactly at the Shanxi-Shaanxi-Henan corner on the river bend and ties the three counties together; the town itself is only 6% of people.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 64 hits with Shanxi, top ones about the ferry and town.
candidates.source_note: 山西、陕西、河南三省的交界点（今山西省芮城县风陵渡镇）

candidates.name: Lingbao
candidates.meaning: "Spirit treasure": renamed in Tang after a sacred talisman of Laozi was found there.
candidates.fit: 49% of the people and 56% of the area, but the region is a three-province bend, so a Henan county name fits the other 51% poorly.
candidates.recognisability: Current county-level city.
candidates.source_note: 唐明皇时在此地发现太上老君“灵符”，故改名为“灵宝”

regions.notes: Hangu pass itself was not proposed: the current Hangu town is in Lingbao but the name is a pass, and Hangu is also a district in Tianjin. Guozhou was not checked.
